description: This file defines the TransactionManagerExtension class, which implements the ITransactionManagerExtension interface to manage transaction operations within the Orleans framework. It provides methods for pinging, preparing, committing, and updating the status of transactions, utilizing resource factories and transaction managers.

classes.name: TransactionManagerExtension
classes.description: Implements transaction management extension methods for Orleans transactions, managing transaction managers per resource.

methods.name: TransactionManagerExtension
methods.description: Constructor initializing the resource factories and managers dictionary using the grain context accessor.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Pings a transaction resource to check its activity status.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Prepares and commits a transaction across multiple write resources.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Updates the status of a transaction participant.

methods.name: GetManager
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a transaction manager for a given resource ID.
